senses.sense_definition: Advocacy or appreciation of rural life and values over urban living.

examples.text: His philosophy was defined by an ardent <w>ruralism</w> that rejected the stresses of city life.
The author argued that modern <w>ruralism</w> romanticizes agricultural hardship while ignoring economic realities.

senses.sense_definition: The way of life or state of living in the countryside.

examples.text: After decades in the metropolis, they retired to a quiet <w>ruralism</w> in the mountains.
The rapid spread of industry ended generations of peaceful <w>ruralism</w> in the valley.

senses.sense_definition: The state, quality, or character of being rustic or characteristic of the countryside.

examples.text: The decor captured an authentic <w>ruralism</w> with its exposed wooden beams and antique tools.
Critics praised the novel for the charming <w>ruralism</w> that pervaded its descriptions of small-town life.

senses.sense_definition: A word, phrase, or idiom characteristic of rural speech.

examples.text: The dialogue is sprinkled with occasional <w>ruralisms</w> that reflect the speaker's upbringing.
She collected regional <w>ruralisms</w> to document the traditional dialect before it disappeared.
